title: Daily brief
ask: Write me a short brief of what happened in the company since yesterday. Cover only things that need no decision from me: what was finished, what is in progress and who has it, which drafts were approved or sent back, anything an agent learned that is worth knowing, and anything that looks late. Give at most eight items, each one to three lines, in plain words. Leave out anything that needs a decision from me, because those are already waiting under Needs you. If nothing happened, say so in one line.
